parentCommit: b825c56c Document DXF inspector closure lifetime
scope: Refuse VIEWPORT typed DXF output for enum values outside the published Autodesk domains without tightening DWG parsing or encoding.

authority.source: Autodesk VIEWPORT DXF reference and DXF group-code reference

implementation.behavior: DRW_Viewport::validateDxf now layers the documented group 281, 282, and 79 enum domains over the existing payload-width checks. dxfRW::writeViewport uses this DXF-only validation. DWG parseDwg and encodeDwg continue to use validatePayloadFields, preserving wire-width decoding/encoding behavior.
implementation.failureBehavior: ASCII and Binary typed DXF writes reject values 7, 2, and 7 respectively before emitting the VIEWPORT record; a preexisting destination prefix remains unchanged.

focused.coverage: Both ASCII and Binary: each out-of-domain enum is refused without changing a preexisting destination; the documented maxima 6/1/6 serialize and the DXF reader observes exact groups 79/281/282 values. Existing VIEWPORT reference remapping and failure controls in the same selector pass.

limits: No physical VIEWPORT producer sample or native rendering run was used.
The guard establishes schema-domain output correctness only; it does not qualify viewport rendering, layer override reference fields, graph closure, or whole-document DWG-to-DXF conversion.
No DWG parser or encoder behavior changed, and no support claim was promoted.
next: Continue with a source-backed local output or parser gap. Keep VIEWPORT native rendering and physical producer qualification open.
